the La2O 3 MoO3 HZSM5 catalyst is active for the production of styrene from methane in the presence of molecular oxygen.
the La2O 3 MoO3 catalyst is active for the transformation of methane to ethane, ethene, CH3, CH2 and CH species.
the mixed catalyst of lanthanum oxide and molybdena on HZSM5 is active for the transformation of CH4 to styrene in the presence of molecular oxygen.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the conversion of methane to styrenes over the mixed catalyst La 2O 3MoO 3HZSM 5.
the conversion of CH4 in a CH4/O 2 reactant gas mixture over La2O 3, MoO 3/HZSM5 and La2O3MoO3/H ZSM5 catalysts.
the conversion of methane to styrenes in the presence of an oxygen-containing reactant over the catalysts La2O3/HZMS 5 and La2O3MoO3/H ZMS 5.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the La2O 3 MoO3 catalyst, which was prepared from La2O3/HZMS 5 and MoO3/H ZSM 5, is a highly active catalyst for methane conversion in the presence of a small amount of oxygen.
the mixed catalyst La2O3MoO3/H ZSM 5 is a very active and selective catalyst for the transformation of CH4 to styrene.
the catalytic activity of the La2O 3 MoO3 HZSM-5 catalyst is due to the synergetic effects between the MoO3 component and the HZSM- 5 zeolite.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
methane is transformed into styrene via ethane, ethene, CH2 species and CH3 species over the La2 O3 MoO3 /HZSM 5 catalyst.
the combination of La2O3 and MoO3/Hzsm-5 is an effective catalyst for the conversion of methane to styrenes.
the La2O 3 MoO3 HZSM5 catalyst can catalyze methane to styrene via a route that involves the formation of ethane, and ethylene and then the dehydrogenated intermediates of ethylene and styrene.

the combination of La2O3 and MoO3/H ZSM 5 is a promising candidate for the conversion of methane to styrenewhich is an important intermediate in the synthesis of polystyrene.
